plan.archetype: Efficient attacks into flexible scaling and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Bring sustained damage, upgraded mitigation, healthy HP, and a defensive potion. Prepare sufficient block for the post-kill explosion.
plan.summary: Add efficient damage first, then develop scaling, draw, and defense around the relics. Remove Strikes after securing replacement damage. Fight elites only with adequate preparation and recovery available.

plan.archetype: Bandages discard defense with efficient attacks and poison scaling
plan.bossPrep: Build sustained damage and discard-generated block. Upgrade key attacks and preserve a defensive potion for the post-kill explosion.
plan.summary: Spend chest gold on discard engines and damage. Keep the recovery route, heal at the next fire, then upgrade key cards. Remove basics as replacements arrive; Greed cannot be removed.

plan.archetype: Bandages discard defense with sustained damage
plan.bossPrep: Improve sustained damage to shorten steam growth. Preserve retained Gamble for explosion defense when safe. Use regeneration early enough to realize healing.
plan.summary: Heal now and retain the low-combat route. Prioritize sustained damage and Bandages synergy over additional basics. Remove Strikes first; upgrade Prepared, Neutralize, or damage when health permits.

plan.archetype: Bandages discard defense with sustained poison scaling
plan.bossPrep: Build sustained poison and reliable discard defense. Stock protective potions, face Rocket during lasers, and account for the surviving crab’s enrage.
plan.summary: Take delayed energy. Shop for poison scaling, discard engines, and potions; remove Strikes first. Follow three fires and one late elite. Heal when needed; otherwise upgrade Prepared and key scaling.

plan.summary: Build around Bandages rather than adding generic block. Prioritize scaling and draw; remove new removable curses before Strikes. Follow three fires and one late elite. Heal when threatened; otherwise upgrade engine cards.
